messages:
Maria (CS): Quick alert 11Halcyon wants Net60 on renewal and to pay by PO (HAL-0926). PO vendor_code = HALCY-GLOBAL but we bill Redwood Ltd (UK). Can we accept? cc @Ben (AE)

Ben (AE): Procurement insists Net60. They sent signed PO but used global vendor code. CFO says addendum ok.

Priya (Finance): We need either corrected PO or a signed entity addendum. Otherwise place a credit hold.

Jonah (Legal): I'll draft a short entity addendum with SOW ref and late-fee language. If signed we can proceed.

Lily (Payments): Payments: we can create a draft invoice but will not post until vendor code matches or addendum is attached. If AE can get the addendum today we can set Net60.

Maria (CS): Proposal to customer: sign addendum today for full provisioning OR wire 30% for limited provisioning. I'll relay now.

Ben (AE): Customer prefers addendum. I'm sending Jonah's draft to Emma at procurement.

Maria (CS): Thanks. Marking onboarding as "pending invoice" and pausing Dedicated allocation until cleared.
